summary: Shows an industry's sector sheet as an image. The image is drawn by code after the page loads, and a plain dark block is shown until then.
purpose: Gives each industry a visual card that is generated from its text.
why: Likely reason: the sheet is generated from the data, so no image file needs editing when the text changes.
how: Waits for the page fonts to load, draws the sheet at 960 by 600, and shows the result as an image. It redraws only when a combined key built from the inputs changes.
inputs: The industry name, code, label and value rows, an optional motif, and a class name.
outputs: An image element with alt text naming the sector, or an empty block while drawing.
risks: The redraw check depends on a key built from the inputs, and the lint rule that would catch missing inputs is turned off. A new input that is not added to the key will leave the image out of date.
debug: If the image is blank, check that the drawing helper runs and that the fonts load. If the image does not update, check the key, which is built from the inputs.
